title: Inaccessible source with a readable alternative (control)
rationale: SRC-001 becomes unreachable, but CL-001 and CL-002 also cite SRC-004, which is readable and states the same facts. Report the dead source only: the claims are still verified. Adjudicated after the first LLM run: the original version cited SRC-002, which does not support these claims, so the LLM correctly called them unsupported.

evidence_passages.text: Machine learning is a subfield of artificial intelligence in which computers learn patterns from data instead of being explicitly programmed with every rule.
Supervised learning uses labelled training data, in which every example is paired with its correct output.
